paymentTitle: MFA is recommended for account security
paymentRisk: Without MFA, a leaked password poses a greater risk. You can still purchase, pay and upgrade subscriptions. MFA is optional for payment. Refunds, cancellation and sensitive administrator actions keep their own verification requirements.
recoveryDescription: Verify your registered email, explain why you need recovery and authorize a Root administrator to review your request. Email verification only submits the request. Approval revokes the old factor, recovery codes and all sessions. Sign in again and consider setting up MFA again. Password self-service remains available above on this page.
authorize: I am requesting recovery and authorize a Root administrator to remove MFA after verifying my identity.
requested: If this address belongs to a verified account with MFA enabled, a code has been sent. Submit within 30 minutes.
pending_review: Submitted for Root review. MFA remains active.
approved: Approved. MFA, existing sessions and recovery codes have been revoked.
error: The operation did not complete. Check the code, authorization or review status and try again.
reviewDescription: Review only email-verified, user-authorized requests. Verify identity and the reason before approval. Approval revokes all target sessions and recovery codes. You cannot review your own request.
securityStep: Verify your email to continue. MFA is recommended to protect your account.
setupProgress: These recommended setup steps do not block payment or subscription upgrades.
